skill.summary: 后台系统/运营平台/销售系统的需求单操作指南。当用户提到需求单、线索管理、审核需求单，或需要登录后台/运营端/平台端（xiaonei-web）处理学校需求时，必须使用此技能。包含完整的 CAS 统一登录平台登录流程、需求单列表页和详情页操作、审核状态流转等。适用于 haoduo.vip 域名下的运营管理系统。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the sales-clue skill with full operation guides for the sales requirement system.

- Provides comprehensive instructions for managing sales requirement forms (需求单) in the haoduo.vip backend/运营平台/销售系统.
- Covers unified CAS login steps, including when and how to request user credentials.
- Details standard operations: viewing, creating, editing, submitting, and auditing requirement forms.
- Includes page layouts, search/filter options, environment/domain rules, and common process flows.
- Strictly mandates using formal environment by default, only switching per user request.
- Emphasizes a "try action first, only inquire if necessary" user interaction principle.
